question: What claim of instruction is made by the speaker's promise to speak the method of names to the beautiful-eyed one?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names of them.
The recipient is addressed as beautiful-eyed one.
The recipient is commanded to hear.
inference: The speaker promises to instruct the beautiful-eyed one in the method of their names, and bids her to hear.
uncertainties: The list of names is not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beautiful-eyed one, hear; I shall speak to you the method of their names.
